lines.en: label beachmas2:
At night, I reach the end of days — but only until morning.
lines.zh: 夜里，我抵达末日的尽头——但只到清晨为止。

lines.en: Every time I close my eyes, I die — but I can’t sleep because it’s pouring.
lines.zh: 每次我闭上眼睛，我就死去——可我睡不着，因为外面大雨倾盆。

lines.en: So as the clouds conceal the sun and the sky continues storming;
lines.zh: 于是当乌云遮住太阳、天空继续暴雨不止；

lines.en: I’ll tell myself I love you — for if I don’t, it gets too boring.
lines.zh: 我会告诉自己我爱你——因为若不这样，就太无聊了。

lines.en: - Me, who’s right behind you
lines.zh: ——我，就在你身后

lines.en: scene yumisawathing1
At night, a stack of silver coins drops further down a well.
lines.zh: 夜里，一叠银币落进井中，越落越深。

lines.en: A well so deep it cuts through heaven before circling back to hell.
lines.zh: 那口井深到先穿过天堂，再绕回地狱。

lines.en: What does it mean, o Sekai!? What is the point, pray tell!?
lines.zh: 这是什么意思啊，Sekai！？到底有什么意义，求你告诉我！？

lines.en: There is no point, my child — There is nothing but a shell.
lines.zh: 没有意义，我的孩子——除了一具空壳，什么都没有。

lines.en: - Me, again. Turn around.
lines.zh: ——又是我。转过身来。

lines.en: I can’t KILL this FUCKING headache but I can hurt MYSELF instead!
lines.zh: 我杀不死这该死的头痛，但我可以转而伤害自己！

lines.en: It’s okay because my BLOOD is words! My veins are just PRETEND!
lines.zh: 没关系，因为我的血是文字！我的血管只是假装的！

lines.en: Rapist! Lecher! Pedophile! Flay her ‘til she’s DEAD!
lines.zh: 强奸犯！好色之徒！恋童癖！把她活活剥皮！

lines.en: The things they’d say if only they could see inside my head.
lines.zh: 若他们能看见我脑袋里的东西，他们就会这样说。

lines.en: - IT’S STILL ME. IT HAS ALWAYS BEEN ME. IT WILL ALWAYS BE ME.
lines.zh: ——还是我。一直都是我。永远都会是我。

lines.en: scene halftone
{size=+25}{b}I MISS YOU SO MUCH.{/b}{/size}
lines.zh: {size=+25}{b}我好想你。{/b}{/size}

lines.en: scene yumisawathing1
: {i}The fuck is that guy’s problem? Just saying all that shit out of nowhere...what a fucking creep.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}那家伙有毛病吧？无缘无故就说出那种话……真他妈是个变态。{/i}

lines.en: : {i}Disgusting. Why the hell am I the one being punished for all the...shitty shit that he has done? How is that fair?{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}恶心。凭什么他干的那些……烂事，要由我来受罚？这算哪门子公平？{/i}

lines.en: : {i}I’m not even fucking sad anymore. I’m just grossed out. Like...who straight up {i}admits{/i} that they jerk it to you? Keep that shit to yourself, scumbag.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}我现在连他妈的难过了都算不上。我只是觉得恶心。就像……谁会直白地承认他对着你打飞机啊？那种事自己藏着不行吗，人渣。{/i}

lines.en: scene yumisawathing2
: {i}Or at the bare minimum, maybe wait until I’m not trying to actually open up about-{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}或者最起码，也许等我不是在试着敞开心扉的时候——{/i}

lines.en: : Ah.
scene yumisawathing3
: Uhh...door?
scene yumisawathing4
: Yumi? Door? Please?!
lines.zh: : Yumi？门？拜托？！

lines.en: scene yumisawathing5
: Oh! Uhh, yeah! My bad!
lines.zh: : 噢！呃，对！我的错！

lines.en: scene black
scene yumisawathing6
: Do you, uhh...need something? Preferably something small that I could slip through the bottom of the door so you can just leave afterward?
lines.zh: : 你，呃……有什么事吗？最好是那种小小的、我能从门缝底下塞过去、然后你就可以走了的东西。

lines.en: : My bag is in there...I wanted to...put my normal clothes back on.
lines.zh: : 我的包在里面……我想……换回我平时的衣服。

lines.en: : Right. Yeah. Cool. I mean, we’ve only {i}been{/i} here for a good half hour or so and I kind of figured most people would stay in their swimsuits for longer than that, but...right on. Yeah.
lines.zh: : 对。行。酷。我是说，我们才{i}来了{/i}大概半个钟头，我本来以为大多数人穿泳装的时间会比这更久，不过……行吧。对。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing7
: Okay. Uhh...
: I guess it’s...your turn to get changed in the fleeting privacy of a room that people are customarily supposed to, like...knock before they go inside.
lines.zh: : 那看来……轮到你在那种转瞬即逝的私密里换衣服了——在那种按惯例进门前应该……敲一下的房间里。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing8
: Yeah, I’m...sorry. I had no idea you were even-
lines.zh: : 是啊，我……抱歉。我真不知道你——

lines.en: : Listen, it’s...it’s totally cool.
lines.zh: : 听着，这……这完全没事。

lines.en: : I just...you know, I’d really appreciate it if you could keep what you just saw to yourself. Especially since...it’s something you never {i}should{/i} have seen in the first place.
lines.zh: : 我只是……你知道的，如果你能把刚才看到的东西烂在肚子里，我会非常感激。尤其是……那本来就是你根本{i}不该{/i}看到的东西。

lines.en: : Yeah...yeah, that ain’t no problem. I can do that.
lines.zh: : 对……对，那没问题。我能做到。

lines.en: : But, like...ain’t you the swim team coach? Won’t everybody else-
lines.zh: : 但是，那什么……你不是游泳队的教练吗？其他人不会——

lines.en: scene yumisawathing9
: I mean...{i}technically{/i} speaking...I’m the {i}advisor.{/i} Which is a lot different from a coach. So yeah, I was kind of figuring no one {i}would{/i} ever see me in a swimsuit.
lines.zh: : 我是说……{i}严格来说{/i}……我是{i}顾问{/i}。这和教练差得远了。所以是啊，我本来以为{i}永远不会{/i}有人看到我穿泳装的样子。

lines.en: : And, if they ever {i}did,{/i} that it would be of my choosing rather than just someone walking in on me. But hey, twenty girls means twenty chances of...yeah.
lines.zh: : 就算{i}真{/i}有人看到，那也该是我自己选的，而不是被人就这么闯进来撞见。不过话说回来，二十个女孩就意味着二十次……对。

lines.en: : Anyway, I’m gonna go. So, like...let’s just pretend that none of this ever happened or whatever.
lines.zh: : 总之，我要走了。所以，那个……我们就当这一切从来没发生过之类的吧。

lines.en: : Yeah...okay. That’s cool.
lines.zh: : 行……好吧。没问题。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing10
: R...Rad! See you later, then! Hopefully under some sort of pretense that I can control!
lines.zh: : 太……太棒了！那回头见！希望是在某种我能掌控的名义下！

lines.en: : Yeah...
: See you later...
lines.zh: : 回头见……

lines.en: scene black
scene yumisawathing11
: The fuck was I just thinking of again?
lines.zh: : 我刚才到底在想什么来着？

lines.en: : I can’t even remember why I was mad.
lines.zh: : 我连自己为什么生气都记不起来了。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing12
: Oh, right! That fucking asshole, scumbag teacher just unloading his baggage onto me in the middle of what’s supposed to be a {i}vacation.{/i}
lines.zh: : 噢，对了！那个该死的混蛋人渣老师，在本该是{i}度假{/i}的时候，把他的心理垃圾一股脑倒在我身上。

lines.en: : Is he trying to ruin my weekend? Or did he just think that maybe hearing about his gross ass masturbation habits would make me pity him enough to-
lines.zh: : 他是想毁掉我的周末吗？还是他觉得，也许听他说说他那恶心的打飞机习惯，就能让我同情他到——

lines.en: scene yumisawathing13
: Hey! What are you-
lines.zh: : 嘿！你在——

lines.en: : Hi! Anything you think you might have just heard about masturbation, you didn’t!
lines.zh: : 嗨！任何你以为你刚刚听到的关于打飞机的事，你都没听到！

lines.en: : Uhh...what?
lines.zh: : 呃……什么？

lines.en: scene yumisawathing14
: Nothing. Sup?
lines.zh: : 没什么。怎么了？

lines.en: : Umm...
: Do you want some time {i}alone?{/i} Should I leave the room and come back later?
lines.zh: : 你想{i}一个人{/i}待会儿吗？我要不要先出去，晚点再回来？

lines.en: : Please don’t misinterpret what I just said in the actual worst way possible.
lines.zh: : 千万别用最糟糕的方式曲解我刚才说的话。

lines.en: : To be fair, there aren’t exactly many ways to interpret being greeted by “Hey, I wasn’t masturbating.”
lines.zh: : 说句公道话，被人用「嘿，我刚才没在打飞机」这句话打招呼，可以解读的方式本来就不多。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing15
: That is not even close to what I said!
lines.zh: : 我说的根本不是那个意思！

lines.en: : It might not be {i}exactly{/i} what you said, but I think it was pretty close.
lines.zh: : 也许不是你的{i}原话{/i}，但我觉得已经很接近了。

lines.en: : What kind of psycho would I have to be to intentionally sneak away from the entire class just to...wait, why are we still even talking about this?! Change the topic!
lines.zh: : 我得是什么样的疯子，才会故意从全班人眼皮底下溜走，就为了……等等，我们为什么还在聊这个？！换个话题！

lines.en: : Why me? You’re the one ranting about masturbation. I just wanted to make sure I wasn’t interrupting anything.
lines.zh: : 为什么问我？喋喋不休讲打飞机的人是你。我只是想确认我没有打断什么。

lines.en: : Well...you weren’t!
lines.zh: : 我……你没有！

lines.en: : Okay, then what’s going on? Because I get that you’re {i}you,{/i} but even {i}you{/i} would normally stay at the beach longer than like fifteen minutes before storming off and doing your own thing.
lines.zh: : 好吧，那到底怎么回事？我知道你就是{i}你{/i}，但就算{i}是你{/i}，平时也会在海滩上待够十五分钟以上，才会气冲冲地跑开、自己去干点什么。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing16
: Why does it matter what I do? I’m barely even one of you guys to begin with.
lines.zh: : 我做什么重要吗？反正我本来就算不上你们中的一员。

lines.en: : It matters because you’re my friend and I want to make sure you’re okay.
lines.zh: : 重要，因为你是我的朋友，我想确认你没事。

lines.en: : And also that I now want to make sure that I shouldn’t have just gotten you a vibrator for Christmas instead of new shoes to go with your winter outfit.
lines.zh: : 还有就是，我现在想确认一下，我是不是该给你买个按摩棒当圣诞礼物，而不是配你冬装的新鞋。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing17
: The shoes will be fine, thanks. But maybe cut back on hanging out with our scumbag teacher if it’s going to make you start thinking you should buy me weird adult shit instead of normal presents.
lines.zh: : 鞋子就好，谢了。不过要是跟我们那个人渣老师混在一起，会让你开始想给我买奇怪的成人用品、而不是正常的礼物，那也许还是少跟他来往比较好。

lines.en: : Scumbag? But I thought you and Sensei finally started patching things up?
lines.zh: : 人渣？可我还以为你和 Sensei 终于和好了呢？

lines.en: : What? That’s news to me.
lines.zh: : 什么？我怎么不知道。

lines.en: : Sides, even if we {i}did,{/i} which we won’t, it wouldn’t make him any less of a predatorial douche.
lines.zh: : 再说，就算我们{i}和好{/i}了——我们不会的——那也不会让他变得不那么像个捕食者一样的混蛋。

lines.en: : Sensei might be a lot of things, but he sure as hell isn’t a {i}predator.{/i}
lines.zh: : Sensei 也许有很多毛病，但他绝对不是{i}捕食者{/i}。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing18
: Oh shit, really? Did I go into a coma or something? Do I have amnesia? At what point did everyone in our class grow up? Because I sure as fuck missed it.
lines.zh: : 噢操，真的吗？我是昏迷了还是怎么的？我失忆了吗？我们班的人到底是从什么时候开始长大的？因为我他妈肯定是错过了。

lines.en: : Legal definitions are stupid. He’s too nice to be a predator.
lines.zh: : 法律定义是蠢的。他太好了，不可能是捕食者。

lines.en: : You being brainwashed by {i}love{/i} doesn’t make him any less creepy or any less predatorial. He’s fucked up and that’s that.
lines.zh: : 你被{i}爱情{/i}洗脑了，并不会让他变得不那么恶心、不那么像个捕食者。他就是有病，就这样。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing19
: Yeah, but so are you. And so am I. None of us are perfect.
lines.zh: : 是啊，可你也有病。我也有。没人是完美的。

lines.en: : True. But not all of us wake up and decide to break the law every single day.
lines.zh: : 没错。但不是每个人每天都一睁眼就决定去犯法。

lines.en: : You literally steal candy from convenience stores and sell it to kids.
lines.zh: : 你还不是从便利店偷糖卖给小孩。

lines.en: : {i}Did,{/i} Chika. Soon as Tsukasa gives me my 10k, I’m leavin’ that life behind.
lines.zh: : {i}那是过去式了{/i}，Chika。等 Tsukasa 把那一万块给我，我就金盆洗手了。

lines.en: : That sounds a lot like you telling me Sensei is going to leave me behind once he finds a girl closer to his age.
lines.zh: : 这话听起来很像你在告诉我，Sensei 一旦找到年龄更接近的女孩就会把我甩了。

lines.en: : Wasn’t trying to say that. Nor do I think he would because he’s a fucking creep and a girl like you is basically a lottery win for him.
lines.zh: : 我不是那个意思。我也不觉得他会，因为他就是个该死的变态，而像你这样的女孩对他来说基本上等于中了彩票。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing20
: Aww! Yumi! That's so sweet!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！Yumi！你太贴心了！

lines.en: : It ain’t {i}supposed{/i} to be. That’s the thing.
lines.zh: : 我{i}可不是{/i}在夸你。这就是问题所在。

lines.en: : You’re great. You’re everything, like...any dude could ever want. So why waste all of that on a {i}predator{/i} when there are bound to be people out there a million times better for you?
lines.zh: : 你很好。你就是……任何男人都想要的一切。那何必把这一切浪费在一个{i}捕食者{/i}身上——外面肯定有一百万个更适合你的人？

lines.en: scene yumisawathing21
: Well, ignoring the fact that most of those people are in space...Sensei is the one I fell for. Flaws and all.
lines.zh: : 好吧，先无视那些人大多在太空里这一点……Sensei 就是我爱上的人。连他的缺点一起。

lines.en: : There’s no logic behind it or anything. In fact, I don’t think there’s ever really {i}any{/i} logic in anything involving love as it sort of just works in the background without us ever really doing anything.
lines.zh: : 这背后没有任何逻辑。事实上，我觉得{i}任何{/i}跟爱情有关的事都没什么逻辑，因为它就像是在后台自己运转着，我们根本什么都没做。

lines.en: : Like...Okay, I haven’t asked you this in a while, but what kind of guys are you into, Yumi?
lines.zh: : 那什么……好吧，我有阵子没问你了，Yumi 你喜欢什么样的男生？

lines.en: : You know I don’t think about that shit.
lines.zh: : 你知道我不想那种破事。

lines.en: : I know you {i}say{/i} you don’t think about that shit, but I know you’re lying. Ignoring the fact you still don’t want to tell me, though...do you know {i}why{/i} you feel that way? Or do you just...you know...do?
lines.zh: : 我知道你{i}说{/i}你不想，但我知道你在撒谎。不过先不管你还是不肯告诉我……你知道自己{i}为什么{/i}会有那种感觉吗？还是你就是……你知道的，就这样？

lines.en: : Hey, let’s talk about masturbating again. That sounds easier than this.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我们还是聊回打飞机吧。那个比这个容易。

lines.en: : Sure. What kind of guys do you masturbate to?
lines.zh: : 行。你会对着什么样的男生打飞机？

lines.en: scene yumisawathing22
: What? You set me up for that one.
lines.zh: : 什么？这可是你给我铺的梗。

lines.en: : Point is, when it comes to love, once you learn to look past somebody’s flaws and see who they are on the inside, all of that other stuff doesn’t really matter.
lines.zh: : 重点是，说到爱情，一旦你学会忽略一个人的缺点、看见他内在的样子，其他那些东西就都不重要了。

lines.en: : Be honest. Do you {i}actually{/i} think Sensei is a bad guy? Or do you think he’s just a little...fucked up?
lines.zh: : 说实话。你{i}真的{/i}觉得 Sensei 是坏人吗？还是你觉得他只是有点……有病？

lines.en: : I think he’s a bad guy who is {i}a lot{/i} fucked up. Not a little.
lines.zh: : 我觉得他是个坏人，而且{i}病得很重{/i}。不是有点。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing23
: He has his moments, I guess...but they’re so few and far between that they barely make any sort of dent in who he is overall.
lines.zh: : 他也有闪光的时候吧，我猜……但太少太远，几乎没在他整个人上留下什么痕迹。

lines.en: : And yet...you spend so much of your time thinking about him. In fact, you probably bring the guy up just as much as I do.
lines.zh: : 然而……你花那么多时间想他。事实上，你提起那家伙的次数搞不好跟我一样多。

lines.en: : And hey, since this is honesty-hour, I guess I can go ahead and say that it actually kind of pisses me off sometimes.
lines.zh: : 而且嘿，既然现在是坦诚时间，那我就直说了——有时候这其实还挺让我火大的。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing24
: Huh?
: It’s one thing to not like someone. But seizing every opportunity you get to shit on them even when they’re not relevant is like, a major red flag.
lines.zh: : 不喜欢一个人是一回事。但抓住每一个机会去踩人家，哪怕跟他根本没关系时也要踩，那就是一个大写的危险信号。

lines.en: : What are you saying?
lines.zh: : 你什么意思？

lines.en: scene yumisawathing25
: I’m saying that if you {i}do{/i} like the same person as me...that you better fucking tell me about it instead of just locking it away.
lines.zh: : 我的意思是，如果你{i}真的{/i}喜欢上了和我一样的人……那你最好他妈的跟我说清楚，而不是把它锁起来。

lines.en: : But why would-
lines.zh: : 可是我为什么要——

lines.en: : Because if you do the latter, it’s going to blow up in your face {i}and{/i} mine and we’re never going to recover from it.
lines.zh: : 因为如果你选后者，它会炸在你{i}和{/i}我的脸上，我们就再也回不去了。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing26
: Dude, I’m not-
lines.zh: : 姐们，我没有——

lines.en: : To clarify before you get mad, I’m not accusing you of anything.
lines.zh: : 在你生气之前先说明白，我不是在指控你什么。

lines.en: : I’m just telling you, as a friend, that the right thing to do is to be honest with me. Because I’ve always been honest with you.
lines.zh: : 我只是作为朋友告诉你，正确的做法是对我诚实。因为我一直都对你诚实。

lines.en: : Also, I was only half joking about my threesome offer a while ago.
lines.zh: : 另外，我之前那个三人行的提议，有一半是认真的。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing27
: Why do you always have to ruin everything like that?
lines.zh: : 你为什么非得每次都这么把气氛搞砸？

lines.en: : Just the kind of girl I am, I guess.
lines.zh: : 大概我就是这种女孩吧。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing28
: But for real, what are you doing over here while everybody else is off having fun?
lines.zh: : 不过说真的，别人都在玩，你在这儿干什么？

lines.en: : I think not having fun is more fun than having fun most of the time.
lines.zh: : 我觉得大多数时候，不开心比开心更开心。

lines.en: : That was a weird sentence.
lines.zh: : 这句话怪怪的。

lines.en: : Probably just need to cool off or some shit. I don't know.
lines.zh: : 大概就是需要冷静一下之类的。我也不知道。

lines.en: : Somebody said they saw you talking to Sensei before you stormed off. That have anything to do with it?
lines.zh: : 有人说你冲走之前在跟 Sensei 说话。跟那有关吗？

lines.en: : Maybe. Probably. Who knows?
lines.zh: : 也许吧。大概是。谁知道呢？

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: : 我明白了。

lines.en: : So, let me just circle back to the masturbation thing then-
lines.zh: : 那么，让我再绕回打飞机那个话题——

lines.en: scene yumisawathing29
: I’d really prefer you didn’t.
lines.zh: : 我真的希望别。

lines.en: : I’m kidding. If you don’t mind, though, I’m down to hang out here and “not have fun” with you for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 我开玩笑的。不过你要是不介意，我倒愿意在这儿陪你「不开心」一会儿。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta do some brainstorming for Sensei’s present anyway as I’m still not really sure what the best way to pull it off is.
lines.zh: : 反正我还得给 Sensei 的礼物想点子，我一直不太确定怎么把它办成才最好。

lines.en: : You planning some sort of romantic grand gesture or some shit? Sounds gross.
lines.zh: : 你在策划什么浪漫的大动作之类的？听着就恶心。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing30
: Something like that. Not a Secret Santa thing, though. Just a normal ole romantic present exchanged between student and teacher.
lines.zh: : 差不多吧。不过不是秘密圣诞老人那种。就是学生和老师之间很普通的一份浪漫礼物。

lines.en: : Think he’ll actually get {i}you{/i} something this year?
lines.zh: : 你觉得他今年真会给{i}你{/i}准备什么吗？

lines.en: : I hope...
lines.zh: : 我希望……

lines.en: : Though, he does already pay for my phone...and {i}your{/i} phone, so yeah.
lines.zh: : 虽然他已经替我付了手机费……还有{i}你{/i}的手机费，所以嘛。

lines.en: : Don’t remind me.
lines.zh: : 别提醒我。

lines.en: scene yumisawathing31
: Speaking of Secret Santa, though...who’d you get? Anyone fun? Are you excited?
lines.zh: : 不过说到秘密圣诞老人……你抽到了谁？有意思的人吗？你兴奋吗？

lines.en: : Excited for...giving a gift? The fuck do you think I am? Course I ain’t excited. That’s money I could be usin’ on myself.
lines.zh: : 兴奋？送礼物？你把我当什么了？我当然不兴奋。那可是我能花在自己身上的钱。

lines.en: : I hope it’s Nodoka. That would be hilarious.
lines.zh: : 我希望是 Nodoka。那会很好笑。

lines.en: : Close. I got Futaba. Easy to shop for, though. Probably just gonna grab some random book at a gas station or some shit.
lines.zh: : 差不多。我抽到 Futaba。不过很好买。大概就在加油站随便抓本书之类的。

lines.en: : She’s been getting pretty into romance novels lately from what I’ve heard.
lines.zh: : 我听说她最近挺迷言情小说的。

lines.en: : Wow. Exciting.
lines.zh: : 哇。真刺激。

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just trying to help you out since you’ve got like, twenty-four hours left to actually buy something and I know you always wait until the last minute.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我只是想帮你一把，因为你只剩大概二十四小时真的去买东西了，而我知道你向来拖到最后一刻。

lines.en: : Yeah...Actually, instead of hanging out here, why don’t we just get on the bus and head back early? Can go...{i}shopping{/i} or some shit. You like that, right?
lines.zh: : 是啊……不过话说回来，与其在这儿待着，我们干嘛不直接上车早点回去？可以去……{i}逛街{/i}什么的。你喜欢那个，对吧？

lines.en: : I do and nice try.
lines.zh: : 我是喜欢，还有，想得美。

lines.en: : I’ll come with you to the convenience store, but we’re coming back after that. I want to spend more time with that one guy you’re always bringing up. What was his name again?
lines.zh: : 我可以陪你去便利店，但之后我们就得回来。我想多陪陪那个你老是提起的家伙。他叫什么来着？

lines.en: scene yumisawathing32
: Do you even {i}know{/i} his name?
lines.zh: : 你{i}知道{/i}他的名字吗？

lines.en: : Honestly? I’m not even sure if Ami does. I’ve been waiting for her to slip and it legit never happens.
lines.zh: : 老实说？我都不确定 Ami 知不知道。我一直在等她说漏嘴，结果还真从来没发生。

lines.en: : And you haven’t thought of...you know...asking?
lines.zh: : 你就没想过……你知道的……问问？

lines.en: : Nope. I’m in too deep now. Just gotta ride the wave until I figure it out.
lines.zh: : 没。我现在陷得太深了。只能随波逐流，直到我搞明白为止。

lines.en: scene black
: Anyway! I guess I should get dressed. Not sure if the convenience store will let me in half-naked.
lines.zh: : 总之！我想我得去穿衣服了。不确定便利店会不会让我半裸着进去。

lines.en: : Make sure you knock before going into the bedroom. Learned my lesson earlier.
lines.zh: : 进卧室前记得敲门。我今天早些时候已经长记性了。

lines.en: : Oooooh who’d you get to see? Anyone exciting?
lines.zh: : 噢噢噢那你看到谁了？有劲爆的吗？

lines.en: : The fuck does that even mean?
lines.zh: : 你这话到底什么意思？

lines.en: : Hey, I’m just saying...if I opened that door and, like...Tsuneyo or Imani were getting dressed in there, I’d probably hang around for a little while.
lines.zh: : 嘿，我就是说说……要是我打开那扇门，比如……Tsuneyo 或者 Imani 在里面换衣服，我大概会多待一会儿。

lines.en: : Uhh...yeah, I ain’t really sure if you would.
lines.zh: : 呃……是啊，我还真不确定你会不会。

lines.en: $ beachmas2 = True
{i}Meanwhile...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}与此同时……{/i}
